content:
Honest feedback on my Instantly setup before I waste money — does this actually work for hyper-local B2B?
So I'm about to pull the trigger on Instantly and would love some honest opinions before I commit. I'm 19, student in Romania, building an AI receptionist SaaS for small appointment-based businesses — dental clinics, physio, psychology practices. The chatbot handles FAQs and books appointments into Google Calendar 24/7. Incorporating my company end of this month and cold email is my main acquisition channel from day one. Here's what I'm planning: Growth plan + Growth Credits = $77/month. 1,000 leads/month through SuperSearch filtered by industry, job title (owner/manager/doctor), company size 1-15, and has website. 5-email sequence over 14 days. 70% Romania, 30% UK. The thing I'm most unsure about is my rotation strategy. I'm changing niche AND city every month. Delete finished + not interested at end of month to free up the 1,000 contact slots and load fresh leads next month. My ICP is pretty specific — solo dentist or small clinic owner, 1-5 employees, has a website, no chatbot, no online booking. They lose appointments after hours because nobody picks up the phone. That's the exact pain point I'm selling to. A few things I genuinely don't know: For a niche this local and specific, is cold email still the right primary channel or does LinkedIn outreach convert better? I've seen people say LinkedIn works better for certain ICPs but I'm not sure if that applies here. Is the niche + city rotation actually a clean way to avoid duplicate leads or am I overcomplicating it? Any Instantly settings or deliverability things that took you a while to figure out and you wish someone had told you earlier? $77/month reasonable to start or should I be on a higher plan? Not looking for validation — if the whole approach is wrong I'd rather know now than after spending three months on it.
